title: Reported statements · 间接引语（陈述句）
pattern: Subject + said / told + (that) + Subject + backshifted verb
summary: 转述别人的话时，通常把时态往过去推一级，同时调整人称与时间词：She said (that) she was tired.
explanation: **直接引语**是照原话复述，**间接引语**是用自己的话转述，通常使用 said 或 told，that 可以省略：She said **(that)** she **was** tired.（她说她累了）。中文不需要改动动词，英语却要把时态“往过去推”一级。
这种变化叫做**时态后移**（backshift）：一般现在时变为一般过去时（is → was，do → did）；现在进行时变为过去进行时；现在完成时变为过去完成时（have → had）；一般过去时变为过去完成时；will 变为 would，can 变为 could。例如：“I **am** tired,” she said. → She said she **was** tired.
人称、时间和地点词也要随着说话人的位置而改变：I 变为 he 或 she，my 变为 his 或 her；now 变为 then，today 变为 that day，tomorrow 变为 the next day，yesterday 变为 the day before，here 变为 there。
如果转述的内容至今仍然是真理或长期有效的事实，可以不改时态：The teacher said the Earth **goes** around the Sun.（地球绕着太阳转，这是一个不变的事实）。中文里的“他说……”在英语里需要根据内容判断，不能机械地全部后移。
注意 say 与 tell 的区别：say 后面通常不直接接人，可以说 say to somebody 或 say that；tell 后面必须接人，表示“告诉某人”：She **told** me that she was tired. 不能写成 She said me that ... 。
mistakes: ✗ He said me he is busy. → ✓ He told me (that) he was busy. tell 后面要直接接人，同时动词 is 应后移为 was。
✗ She said that she will come tomorrow. → ✓ She said that she would come the next day. will 要变为 would，tomorrow 要变为 the next day。
✗ She said me that she was sick yesterday. → ✓ She told me that she was sick the day before. say 后面不能直接接人，同时 yesterday 要改为 the day before。

examples.text: He told me he would call me the next day.
examples.translation: 他告诉我第二天会给我打电话。
examples.note: will 变为 would，tomorrow 变为 the next day。

examples.text: They said they had already finished the work.
examples.translation: 他们说他们已经完成了工作。
examples.note: 现在完成时后移为过去完成时。

examples.text: Tom told me that he had lost his phone the day before.
examples.translation: 汤姆告诉我他前一天把手机弄丢了。

examples.text: The teacher said the Earth goes around the Sun.
examples.translation: 老师说地球绕着太阳转。
examples.note: 科学事实，时态可以保持不变。

examples.text: She told us she could not come to the party.
examples.translation: 她告诉我们她不能来参加聚会。

exercises.sentence: He said he ___ very busy that week.
exercises.explanation: say 是过去式，间接引语中的 is 要后移为 was。

exercises.sentence: She told me she ___ the city the following day.
exercises.translation: 她告诉我第二天她会去那座城市。
exercises.explanation: will 后移为 would，构成 would visit。

exercises.source: 他说他昨天已经回家了。
options: He said he had gone home the day before.
He said he has gone home yesterday.
He says he went home yesterday.
He said he goes home the day before.
exercises.explanation: 转述的过去动作“已经回家”用过去完成时 had gone，yesterday 改为 the day before。

options: He told that he was happy.
They said they would come later.
exercises.explanation: tell 后面要接人，应改为 He told me that he was happy 或 He said that he was happy。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 汤姆说他看过那部电影。
exercises.explanation: 一般过去时 saw 后移为过去完成时 had seen。

exercises.sentence: “I can help you,” he said. → He said he ___ help us.
“I will call you tomorrow,” Ben said. → Ben said he ___ me the next day.
exercises.translation: 本说他第二天会给我打电话。
exercises.explanation: will 后移为 would，tomorrow 改为 the next day。

exercises.source: 她说她明天会来参加会议。
options: She said she will come to the meeting tomorrow.
She said she would come to the meeting the next day.
She said she would come to the meeting yesterday.
She says she comes to the meeting the next day.
exercises.explanation: will 后移为 would，tomorrow 改为 the next day。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 她告诉我她前一天病了。
exercises.explanation: tell 后面接人 me，then that 从句的时态后移为 was。
